overview.description: The First Trust Value Line Dividend Index Fund (FVD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Value Line Dividend index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of dividend-paying companies. The index excludes companies with less than $1 billion in market cap, risky ranking and lower-than-average dividend yield. FVD was launched on Aug 19, 2003 and is issued by First Trust.
